pairs.why: Near-identical hats, but B's band is smooth satin while A's is visibly ribbed, so B sits closer to the real cards' smoother, less textured finish.
A's band is smooth satin and B's is ribbed; with the hat shapes nearly identical, the less textured A is closer to the real cards.
B's smooth red band beats A's ribbed band at matching the soft, low-texture finish of the real cards; the hats are otherwise the same.
A has the smoother satin band and B the ribbed one, so A is slightly closer to the real cards' smooth finish.
Both have the same ribbed band and lightly textured crown, and I can't see a meaningful difference in finish or build.
Both bands are ribbed and both crowns have the same faint fabric texture; only the brim width differs, and not in a way that matters here.
